messages:
vivian: Quick sync — OrbitWorks marketplace listing + HW SKU push. Need owners for assets, SI validation, legal quote, price band. Who can take what?

raj: I can own SI validation and run the sample deploys. Scheduling test today 16:00 UTC.

dana: OrbitWorks dropped a first asset pack but SKU mapping CSV missing. PM said will export by EOD. I can accept placeholders for staging.

oliver: Landing microcopy in flight. Ill push a draft to /staging by 08:30 PT tomorrow and flag any image dependencies.

vivian: Embargo set to 2026-04-20T18:00:00Z. All public assets + legal signoff required T-24h before. Mark that as non-negotiable.

raj: SI test runbook (short):
```
- checkout release/orbitwork-marketplace
- deploy connector v1.3.0
- run smoke: ./ci/smoke.sh --sku ORBIT-X1
- run integration: ./ci/integrate.sh --env staging --partner orbitworks
- verify logs: tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/connector.log | grep -i "handshake ok"
- upload screenshots to drive: Partnerships/OrbitWorks/tests/
```
If firmware mismatch occurs well follow fallback (see below).

dana: Fine to publish low-res PNGs for preview, final assets must be 2x retina by cutover. Ill tag any non-compliant items in the content tracker.

oliver: I added analytics tag to capture partner.sku and partner.region. Created INF-8299 to make sure token-level metrics include partner metadata.

deploy-bot: preview-check started (job 9051)
deploy-bot: preview-check succeeded 44c no broken links detected

vivian: Two asks before we mark launch-ready: 1) @dana confirm CDN path for images; 2) @marco confirm pricing tier to show on listing (vendor asks for a nominal band).

marco: Confirming price band: Tier B recommended. Ive added the entry to the marketplace pricing sheet and updated metadata so the listing will show the correct MSRP band.

raj: Integration fallback: if OrbitWorks firmware incompatible during final validation, we publish listing with badge "integration pending" and disable the one-click deploy; provide clear notes for customers.

dana: I escalated the legal quote request to OrbitWorks marketing (template: 1 sentence on performance + 1 on partnership). Expect reply by tomorrow 11:30 PT.

oliver: Minor copy note: want partner-supplied benchmark numbers only if theyve been verified by our eng. Otherwise use qualitative phrasing.

vivian: Agreed. Final dry-run planned 14:00 PT tomorrow if all tests pass. If there are no blockers by 13:00 PT we call this "launch-ready".

deploy-bot: embargo configured for 2026-04-20T18:00:00Z 0% release gated by approvals and the "partner-asset-approved" tag.

vivian: Thanks everyone 44d document results and screenshots in Partnerships/Marketplace/OrbitWorks/launch-playbook.md and add postmortem notes if we use the fallback.
